result_summary.title: Unexpected chargebacks and overcharges in Staging
result_summary.description: We are testing the Payment Gateway v2 in our US-West staging environment. We have received simulated chargeback notices, and we also observed that some transactions are being overcharged. Since this is staging, there is no immediate business impact on real customers, but we need to understand why these billing errors are occurring before promoting to production.
